subject: Inca tern pair on a rocky ledge
creator: Darío De la Fuente
alt: An Inca tern spreads its wings while mounted on another tern on a rocky ledge; the lower bird turns its head toward its partner.
detail: The source shows a mating pair, not an accidental landing. Ines is cast as the lower bird. Foot placement sequence, wing brushing, dismounting and affectionate leaning afterward are fiction. No offspring or successful fertilization is asserted.
